verdict.rationale: Cekura is built around pre-production simulation: synthetic conversations run before go-live (cekura-docs-19), and agents can be built and tested on the platform without external API keys or integrations (cekura-docs-16). Mock tools return predictable responses so agent tool calls need not hit real backends (cekura-docs-23). However, no evidence describes a dedicated sandbox or test environment, separate test and production projects, or any guarantee that production data stays isolated. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test-environment feature, documented separation of test and production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation.
